**Price**
The NE301 is listed on the official store at **$199.90 – $258.00**, with the NE301 PoE variant priced at **$258** [4][8]. A draft customer reply also cites an estimated retail price of approximately **$249** [1]. Volume pricing is available upon request [1].

**How to Order**
Orders can be placed through the online store; the NE301 PoE has a dedicated product page at camthink.ai/store/ne301-poe/ [8]. For volume or tailored quotes, contacting the sales team is recommended — a draft reply to one prospect offered to prepare a custom quote based on target use cases [1].

**Shipping**
The provided documents do not contain specific information about shipping options or delivery methods. Please contact sales for shipping details [1].
